sections.title: CNTRL AND NRN APPALACHIAN MTNS
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH WILL MOVE ACROSS THE LOWER GREAT LAKES TODAY AS A WELL-DEVELOPED MID-LEVEL JET ROUNDS THE BASE OF THE TROUGH. SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD DEVELOP ACROSS MUCH OF THE NERN STATES AS THE EXIT REGION OF A WELL-DEFINED MID-LEVEL JET MOVES EWD ACROSS A RELATIVELY LARGE WARM SECTOR. MODEL FORECASTS DEVELOP MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS MUCH OF THE NERN U.S. WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS WILL RANGE FROM THE MID 60S F IN NEW ENGLAND TO LOWER 70S F ACROSS THE CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS AND MID-ATLANTIC. THIS VERY MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIRMASS ALONG WITH STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR PROFILES EVIDENT ON FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR NUMEROUS SEVERE STORMS THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EARLY EVENING. SUPERCELLS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH CELLS THAT REMAIN DISCRETE AND LARGE HAIL MAY OCCUR WHERE INSTABILITY BECOMES MAXIMIZED. A TORNADO THREAT WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH SUPERCELLS WITH THE GREATEST THREAT LOCATED FROM NRN PA NEWD ACROSS SRN AND CNTRL NY WHERE FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL SHEAR PROFILES. LINEAR ORGANIZATION ALSO APPEARS LIKELY ALONG A FAST MOVING COLD FRONT WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ENHANCED WIND DAMAGE THREAT ACROSS THE CNTRL AND NRN APPALACHIAN MTNS.

sections.title: MID-MO VALLEY/CNTRL AND NRN PLAINS/NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: WEST TO SOUTHWEST FLOW WILL BE IN PLACE TODAY ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS AS SEVERAL DISTURBANCES MOVE ENEWD AND TOP A FLAT UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE IN THE NCNTRL STATES. AT THE SFC...SEVERAL AREAS OF LOW PRESSURE WILL DEEPEN IN THE LEE OF THE ROCKIES WITH STRONG MOISTURE ADVECTION TAKING PLACE TO THE EAST OF THE LOW CENTERS ACROSS THE CNTRL AND NRN PLAINS. SFC DEWPOINTS ARE FORECAST TO BE IN THE UPPER 60S AND LOWER 70S F ALONG AN AXIS FROM THE MID-MO VALLEY EXTENDING WNWWD INTO THE CNTRL AND NRN PLAINS. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS APPEAR LIKELY TO BE ONGOING ALONG THE ERN END OF THE STRONGEST INSTABILITY THIS MORNING IN THE MID-MO VALLEY. ANY MCS ONGOING THIS MORNING ACROSS THE SERN PART OF THE SLIGHT RISK AREA COULD PRODUCE ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AS SFC TEMPS WARM AROUND MIDDAY. FURTHER TO THE NORTHWEST...A CAPPING INVERSION SHOULD BE IN PLACE ACROSS THE CNTRL AND NRN PLAINS WITH THE CAP WEAKENING IN THE AFTERNOON. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD DEVELOP ALONG AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY FROM SRN SD SSEWD ACROSS NEB INTO NERN KS WITH OTHER STORMS DEVELOPING IN ERN CO. FORECAST SOUNDINGS IN CNTRL NEB AND SRN SD BY 00Z SHOW STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR PROFILES AND STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES

sections.title: CENTRAL APPALACHIANS TO NEW ENGLAND THROUGH LATE EVENING
sections.text: A MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL MOVE EWD FROM THE GREAT LAKES TO NEW ENGLAND THROUGH EARLY TONIGHT...ALONG WITH AN ACCOMPANYING SURFACE COLD FRONT. DESPITE RATHER MODEST MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...SURFACE HEATING IN CLOUD BREAKS AND BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S WILL CONTRIBUTE TO AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES OF 1000-1500 J/KG WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR. DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BECOME SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS AND ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS /EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 30-40 KT/. EXPECT SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS TO DEVELOP ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE FRONT BEGINNING AROUND MIDDAY NEAR AND E OF THE LOWER GREAT LAKES...AND STORMS WILL EXPAND IN COVERAGE AND SPREAD EWD ACROSS PA/NY INTO NEW ENGLAND THROUGH THE EVENING. DAMAGING WINDS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREATS GIVEN THE MODERATE INSTABILITY AND LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES. THE THREAT FOR A TORNADO OR TWO WILL BE SOMEWHAT GREATER FROM THE HUDSON VALLEY INTO INTERIOR SRN NEW ENGLAND WHERE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR SHOULD BE GREATEST.

sections.title: MID MS VALLEY/CENTRAL PLAINS THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: A SERIES OF SUBTLE MIDLEVEL VORTICITY CENTERS WILL TRANSLATE NEWD/EWD FROM UT/CO ACROSS KS/NEB TO MO ALONG THE SRN FRINGE OF THE WLYS AND SUPPORT AFTERNOON THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IN THE AREA OF WEAK UPSLOPE FLOW ACROSS NE CO. FARTHER E...LOW-LEVEL WAA IS SUPPORTING AN ONGOING THUNDERSTORM CLUSTER ACROSS NRN KS. THIS CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO EXPAND NWD DURING THE DAY INTO ERN NEB WITH AN ASSOCIATED THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS/HAIL...ESPECIALLY ALONG THE SRN FLANK OF THE CLUSTER WHERE INSTABILITY WILL BE GREATEST. LATER THIS EVENING INTO TONIGHT...CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO EVOLVE INTO ANOTHER MCS ON THE NOSE OF A STRENGTHENING LLJ FROM ERN NEB INTO IA/SW MN. ANOTHER CLUSTER OR TWO OF THUNDERSTORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE TODAY ALONG THE RESIDUAL COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS CENTRAL MO...IN ADVANCE OF A REMNANT MCV WHICH WILL DRIFT EWD FROM NEAR THE KS/MO BORDER. A FEW DAMAGING GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THESE MULTICELL STORMS IN A REGION OF MARGINAL DEEP-LAYER SHEAR.

sections.title: NRN ROCKIES/NRN PLAINS THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: ONGOING CONVECTION ACROSS NW SD/SW ND APPEARS TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH LOW-LEVEL WAA AND AN EMBEDDED MID-UPPER SPEED MAX MOVING EWD FROM MT. THE CONVECTION MAY PERSIST THROUGH THE DAY ACROSS NRN SD INTO SRN ND WITH A MARGINAL RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS/HAIL. OTHERWISE...ADDITIONAL HIGH-BASED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON OVER THE HIGH TERRAIN OF ID/SW MT ON THE NW EDGE OF THE MIDLEVEL MOISTURE PLUME EMANATING FROM THE GREAT BASIN...AND IN ADVANCE OF A TROUGH PROGRESSING EWD FROM OREGON. DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR ORGANIZED CLUSTERS/SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING A FEW DAMAGING GUSTS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL. THE AFTERNOON CONVECTION MAY ALSO EVOLVE INTO A SMALL CLUSTER THAT COULD PERSIST OVERNIGHT WHILE SPREADING EWD OVER S CENTRAL/SE MT. ..THOMPSON/DEAN.. 07/21/2010

sections.title: NORTHEAST UNITED STATES
sections.text: BROAD CYCLONIC FLOW IS IN PLACE TODAY OVER THE NORTHEAST STATES...WITH 12Z UPPER AIR ANALYSIS SHOWING COOL MID LEVEL TEMPERATURES AND STRONG WESTERLY FLOW ALOFT OVER SPREADING NY/PA/NJ AND NEW ENGLAND. STRONG HEATING TODAY WILL COMBINE WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S TO LOWER 70S AND YIELD AFTERNOON MUCAPE VALUES OF 1500-2500 J/KG. ALL MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS WIDESPREAD THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY WILL AFFECT THIS REGION...WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR NUMEROUS DISCRETE CELLS INCLUDING A FEW SUPERCELLS. SEVERE WIND GUSTS ARE THE MAIN THREAT...WITH A RISK OF RATHER WIDESPREAD COVERAGE OF DAMAGING WINDS REPORTS ACROSS THE MODERATE RISK AREA. OTHERWISE...LARGE HAIL AND A FEW TORNADOES ARE ALSO POSSIBLE. THE RISK MAY PERSIST FOR SEVERAL HOURS AFTER SUNSET AS UPPER TROUGH MOVES ACROSS REGION.

sections.title: MID ATLANTIC INTO CAROLINAS
sections.text: SIMILAR TO LAST SEVERAL DAYS...STRONG DAYTIME HEATING WILL OCCUR TODAY ALONG AND EAST OF THE APPALACHIANS FROM WESTERN SC/NC INTO VA. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WILL MOVE OUT OF THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND INTO A VERY MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIR MASS. DESPITE RATHER WEAK FLOW ALOFT...THE STRONGER STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DAMAGING DOWNBURST WINDS.

sections.title: CNTRL THROUGH NRN PLAINS AREA
sections.text: SERIES OF VORTICITY MAXIMA MOVING EWD THROUGH THE CNTRL AND NRN PLAINS WITHIN BELT OF MODERATE WLYS ALONG WITH STRENGTHENING SLY LOW LEVEL JET WILL PROVIDE SOURCES OF LIFT FOR STORMS TO PERSIST INTO THE OVERNIGHT. SEVERAL MULTI-MODAL CLUSTERS OF STORMS ARE CURRENTLY MOVING EWD THROUGH ERN WY...ERN CO INTO NEB AND SD. OTHER STORMS SHOULD INCREASE FROM ERN NEB INTO SERN SD AND IA WITHIN ZONE OF ISENTROPIC LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH LOW-LEVEL JET INTERACTING WITH E-W ORIENTED BAROCLINIC ZONE. MLCAPE FROM 2000 TO 2500 J/KG AND 35-45 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT STORM ORGANIZATION INCLUDING SUPERCELLS AND BOWING SEGMENTS. DAMAGING WIND AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL ARE THE MAIN THREATS. SMALL WINDOW EXISTS BEFORE THE BOUNDARY LAYER BEGINS TO STABILIZE AND DECOUPLE FOR ISOLATED TORNADOES...ESPECIALLY ACROSS NEB INTO SRN SD AS THE STRENGTHENING LOW LEVEL JET AUGMENTS HODOGRAPH SIZE. OVERNIGHT...STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE AS ONE OR MORE MCSS TOWARD THE UPPER MS VALLEY REGION.

sections.title: NERN STATES
sections.text: DEEP LAYER ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH VORTICITY MAXIMA ROTATING THROUGH BASE OF UPPER TROUGH AND NUMEROUS SURFACE BOUNDARIES CONTINUE TO SUSTAIN THUNDERSTORMS OVER THE NERN STATES INCLUDING PORTIONS OF NEW ENGLAND. ATMOSPHERE REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH 1000-1500 J/KG MLCAPE. A 50-60 KT JET STREAK ROTATING THROUGH BASE OF THE UPPER TROUGH IS RESULTING IN 40-50 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR PROMOTING SUPERCELLS AND BOWING SEGMENTS. OVERALL TENDENCY HAS BEEN FOR STORMS TO EVOLVE INTO LINE SEGMENTS...BUT SOME DISCRETE CELLS REMAIN. DAMAGING WIND REMAINS THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT. STORMS WILL UNDERGO A GRADUAL DECREASE LATER THIS EVENING AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER CONTINUES TO STABILIZE. ..DIAL.. 07/22/2010

mesoscale_discussions.topic: HEAVY RAINFALL VALID 220440Z - 220645Z HEAVY RAINFALL WITH LOCALIZED RAINFALL RATES TO 1-2 IN/HR IS LIKELY TO CONTINUE OVERNIGHT WITHIN A CORRIDOR ACROSS FAR NORTHEAST NEB/FAR SOUTHEAST SD TO NORTHWEST IA/FAR SOUTHWEST MN. A WELL-SUSTAINED MID LEVEL IMPULSE/MCV NOW ENTERING FAR SOUTHWEST MN/FAR NORTHWEST IA SHOULD MAINTAIN/SEMI-FOCUS LOCALLY HEAVY RAINFALL ALONG/NORTH OF A WARM FRONT ACROSS NORTHWEST IA/EXTREME SOUTHWEST MN INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS. FARTHER WEST
